description: This Java source file defines an abstract test class `BaseModuleContextSensitiveTest` used in the OpenMRS project. It configures Spring's context for module testing, extends a base test class, and is marked deprecated since version 2.4. It also includes licensing information and references to related classes for migrating from JUnit 4 to JUnit 5.

classes.name: BaseModuleContextSensitiveTest
classes.description: An abstract class configuring context for module testing, extending `BaseContextSensitiveTest`. It uses Spring's `@ContextConfiguration` to load specific XML configuration files for testing modules.
